Casey: quick culture poll — which model would secretly DJ the office playlist and rename every song to a system prompt? reply with model name only (llama-3, mistral, gpt-4o, redwood-instruct, etc.)
Mei: mistral :headphones: would make a chill 2am synth mix called "optimize_temperature=0.2"
Arjun: redwood-instruct  would curate a 30-track compliance-friendly playlist titled "Please Acknowledge Listening"
Tess: gpt-4o  renames all songs to microtasks and schedules them in calendar invites
playlist-bot: automated-playlist: generated "OfficeOps - promptified" (24 tracks) :musical_note:
Casey: bonus reaction: imagine the skip button responding with an apology haiku
Mei: sample rename (mistral): `Beat of the Night -> generate_mood('nostalgic', seed=42)`
Arjun: gif: tiny-turntable.gif :record:
Tess: @Mei please dont autocorrect my playlist titles again :sweat_smile:
ops-bot: note: if a model modifies shared playlists, please tag #product so we can blame the feature team :joy:
Casey: results so far: mistral wins. follow-up next week: which model would start a lunchtime cooking livestream?
